item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00051","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C19","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child's central argument. Both memoranda approve the bill's underlying objective but reject a provision that subjects executive action to congressional committee control outside ordinary enactment and presidential review. They then urge renewed legislation preserving the objective while removing the objectionable mechanism. C19 shares the worthy-objective/serious-defects/re-enactment structure but not the distinctive separation-of-powers machinery; C24 is weaker, sharing only concern about an inadequately considered procedural change.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"If the function of promulgating the contemplated regulations is considered an executive function, it may be exercised solely by the executive.","parent_excerpt":"I do question the propriety and wisdom of giving Committees veto power over executive functions authorized by the Congress to be carried out by executive agencies.","explanation":"Both identify congressional committee control over an assigned executive function as the dispositive defect."},{"child_excerpt":"In requiring officials of the executive branch, other than the President, to put proposed regulations before the Congress and in providing for amendment or disapproval of these by the Congress in a manner not subject to review by the President, these provisions raise serious constitutional questions.","parent_excerpt":"Section 8 of H.R. 6839 requires that every lease-purchase agreement negotiated under authority of this bill receive the approval of the House and Senate Committees... it contains a provision which would infringe upon the functions of the Executive branch","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's congressional-approval objection from lease-purchase agreements to military regulations and develops its constitutional basis more fully."},{"child_excerpt":"I earnestly hope that these objectionable provisions can be eliminated and this legislation reenacted promptly at the next Session of the Congress.","parent_excerpt":"I hope that the Congress will, at its next session, give further consideration to legislation to accomplish the purposes of H.R. 6839, and that it will frame legislation free from the difficulties which impel me to withhold my approval","explanation":"Both close by requesting prompt renewed legislation that retains the favored purpose while eliminating the congressional-control defect."}]}
